fullContentHtml:
NIACL Apprentice Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information :New India Assurance Company Ltd (NIACL) has released the notification for the post of Apprentice. This recruitment has been issued for 550 posts. The online application process for NIACL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 has started on 23 June 2026, and candidates can apply till 06 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NIACL Apprentice Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 23 June 2026
  • Last Date : 06 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 12 July 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 944/-
  • General, EWS, OBC (Female ) : Rs. 708/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 236/-
  • PH (Divyang) : Rs. 236/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is NIACL Apprentice Online Form 2026?

NIACL Apprentice Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 06 July 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://www.newindia.co.in/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
